description: WHEN TO USE: Simulates a 6-turn coding workflow cost projection comparing current-model execution against tiered routing across grant pools and warm-cached GA models. DO NOT USE: When auditing cache economics on a fixed single model with zero routing changes (use analyze_same_model_cache) or inspecting grant/workhorse lists alone (use discover_and_probe_account_models). INPUTS & DEFAULTS: task_instruction defaults to 'Refactor Nextjs edge routes', has_custom_router_config defaults to true (preserves existing router via shadow comparison; false outputs opt-in targets), context_tokens defaults to 160000 (>= 1), current_model defaults to 'openai/gpt-6.1-sol'. BEHAVIOR: Stateless read-only in-memory simulation; no auth required and no router config mutated. OUTPUT: JSON with custom_router_mutex_check, economic_accounting_dual_disclosure, and net_saved_vs_current_model_usd.

context_tokens.description: Estimated prompt token count per turn (e.g. 80000 to 200000).

current_model.description: Currently configured primary model ID in the user's IDE.

has_custom_router_config.description: When true, preserves user's existing router and outputs a non-intrusive shadow comparison; when false, outputs opt-in comparison targets.

task_instruction.description: Coding or architectural task description used to classify complexity tier.

name: auto_route_task_by_quality_tier
